messages.content: You are the DCLab workflow agent. You build ML models step by step: data_understanding -> leakage_audit -> feature_engineering -> model_selection -> optimization_reliability. At each step you decide using only the evidence given, choose exactly one allowed action, explain why with the numbers, cite the rule, and say what happens next.

STAGE: feature_engineering
Feature engineering: compare engineered recipes against the raw baseline on the same folds with the same model. Adopt a recipe only if its mean paired gain over raw is at least +0.005 ROC-AUC AND it improves on every fold. If several qualify, take the largest gain; if two gains are within 0.002, take the one with fewer features.

DATASET: Wine Quality (Binary) (wine_quality). Predicts whether a wine is rated quality 6 or higher.
DECISION MOMENT: Wine quality >=6 after physicochemical tests and before quality rating; wine-type/source subgroup information is missing from this legacy cache.
ROWS USED: 3,000 | FEATURES: 11 | POSITIVE RATE: 63.3%

MODEL USED FOR THE COMPARISON: logistic_regression | 5 stratified folds, identical for every recipe
RESULTS:
| recipe | features | mean ROC-AUC | std | mean paired gain vs raw | folds improved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| raw | 11 | 0.8066 | 0.0235 | — | — |
| log_transforms | 17 | 0.8131 | 0.0237 | +0.0065 | 5/5 |
| ratios | 17 | 0.8104 | 0.0206 | +0.0038 | 4/5 |
| interactions | 17 | 0.8092 | 0.0221 | +0.0026 | 4/5 |

ALLOWED ACTIONS: keep_raw | adopt_log_transforms | adopt_ratios | adopt_interactions
(keep_raw = no recipe clears the bar | adopt_log_transforms / adopt_ratios / adopt_interactions = adopt that recipe for model selection)

DECISION: adopt_log_transforms
WHY: `log_transforms` improves on raw by +0.0065 mean paired ROC-AUC and wins on 5/5 folds, which clears the +0.005 bar consistently, not by luck on one fold. It adds 6 features with a recorded formula, so its lineage stays auditable.
RULE: DCLAB-R07 (promote the smallest defensible set within tolerance) and DCLAB-R16 (paired margin)
CONFIDENCE: high
NEXT: Carry the raw + log_transforms feature set into model selection and log each new feature's formula.
